title: CloudWatch Logs (groups, streams, and Logs Insights)
hook: CloudWatch Logs stores application output in log groups and streams. When metrics show a spike, Logs Insights queries answer why — if you logged structured JSON with correlation IDs.

blocks.text: Log group is the container (/aws/lambda/my-fn). Log stream is a sequence from one instance. Retention defaults to never expire. Logs Insights runs SQL-like queries across groups. Subscription filters stream to Lambda, Kinesis, or Firehose. Metric filters turn log patterns into CloudWatch metrics.

blocks.text: Unstructured printf debugging does not scale across 50 Lambda functions. Structured logs with orderId and trace_id make Insights queries fast during incidents. No retention policy means infinite storage cost.

blocks.title: Interview framing
blocks.body: Say: JSON logs with correlationId. Insights filter and stats. Retention per env. Metric filter for error pattern alarm.

snippet.label: TypeScript — structured log helper
snippet.explanation: Consistent fields enable Insights queries: fields orderId | filter level = 'error'

snippet.label: Logs Insights — duplicate messageId detection
snippet.code:
QUERY='fields @timestamp, messageId, orderId
| filter ispresent(messageId)
| stats count() as cnt by messageId
| filter cnt > 1
| sort cnt desc'

aws logs start-query \
  --log-group-name /aws/lambda/payment-processor \
  --start-time $(date -u -v-1H +%s) \
  --end-time $(date -u +%s) \
  --query-string "$QUERY"
snippet.explanation: Proves duplicate SQS processing — pairs with idempotency metrics.

snippet.label: CloudFormation — log group with retention
snippet.code:
Resources:
  PaymentLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /aws/lambda/payment-processor
      RetentionInDays: 30
  ErrorMetricFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref PaymentLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.level = "error" }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricName: PaymentErrors
          MetricNamespace: Custom/Payments
          MetricValue: '1'
snippet.explanation: JSON filter pattern on structured level field creates alarmable metric.

snippet.label: CLI — set retention on existing groups
snippet.code:
for group in $(aws logs describe-log-groups --query 'logGroups[].logGroupName' --output text); do
  aws logs put-retention-policy \
    --log-group-name "$group" \
    --retention-in-days 14
done
snippet.explanation: Bulk retention fix after cost audit — dev groups can be 7 days.

blocks.title: Pitfalls to avoid
blocks.body: printf strings only — cannot query. No retention — bill surprise. Logging secrets or PII. Huge payloads in log lines — cost and truncation.

blocks.text: How to prove it in production: IncomingBytes metric per log group identifies noisy loggers. Insights query scancost scales with data scanned — narrow time range. Cross-account observability via OAM or centralized logging account. Lambda Powertools Logger standardizes structure.

blocks.title: What gets you rejected in interviews
blocks.body: Saying 'I grep CloudWatch in the console.' Strong answer: structured JSON, Insights queries, correlation IDs, retention policy, metric filters for alarms.

interviewTakeaways: Log group + streams; set retention; structured JSON for Insights.
